observed_problem: WU-012C made compact checkpoints record the current implementation/contract, but canonical Screening/Evidence helpers still called the legacy verify_state_basis contract that required the initialization contract and implementation commit. In addition, the control workflow executes tooling from the edition work branch. A generic fix merged to main therefore could not actually be adopted later in the same edition until its code was integrated into the work branch, and the stage helpers could still reject the newer contract even after integration.
expected_behavior: Initialization identity remains historical provenance. A later stage may use a newer reviewed generic toolchain after ChatGPT integrates the selected reviewed main change into the edition work branch and performs any required targeted revalidation. Stage preparation/validation must accept the current reviewed contract while leaving earlier checkpoint provenance unchanged. Integration conflicts that threaten accepted editorial or approved-byte authority fail closed; ordinary clean integration is not a Human Gate.
actual_behavior: The canonical guidance now requires a reviewed generic main repair to be integrated into the edition work branch before use; the integrated branch head is the execution identity recorded by the next checkpoint. scripts/survey_agent_tool_v2.py is a narrow allowlisted agent-first bridge for legacy Screening/Evidence entrypoints: it validates the resumable agent-first State and actual current work-branch implementation, then delegates while adapting only the historical initialization-pin expectation. scripts/survey_stage_validation_v2.py and survey_agent_control_v2.py bind the actual current implementation/current contract at the lifecycle boundary while preserving initialization and earlier-checkpoint provenance. The production control workflow continues to execute the edition work-branch checkout, so it cannot falsely claim tooling that was never integrated.

provenance.human_review_reference: Post-change five-perspective audit requested by Owner, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Implemented current-stage tool validation and a narrow legacy-helper runtime bridge, and made reviewed-main-to-edition-work-branch integration explicit before adopting a generic fix.
